verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own AuthKit SDKs document session management and automatic token refresh (React, Next.js, Astro, Rust session helpers), and RBAC enforces access through session JWTs. That covers the refresh part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable session expiry or immediate server-side revocation of a compromised session, which is the core security element. missing for 10: documented session expiry/lifetime configuration, server-side session revocation API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
